claim: Scouting pass, no theorem activated. On 12 small cubic bipartite graphs, every Pfaffian one has exactly one sign class with no colouring (the knot's class). Descent by single sign flips that lower the number of colourings reaches it from every class on the three girth-6 Pfaffian graphs (Fano and two 13-point Fano splices), and has traps on exactly the six Pfaffian graphs with 4-cycles (cube 4, prisms 1, trisums 6 and 3, truncated octahedron 14). Non-Pfaffian controls have no zero class. The dynamics is imposed, not native. Interest 1/3 as a standalone epic.
conclusion: No standalone epic; the funnel on Fano spaces is recorded as an observation.
